title: [Notice] Emails from Discord
body:
If you receive an email from Discord and the email address domain is @m.discord.com - it is safe to trust the message and open this email.

Discord owns and uses this @m.discord.com email domain to send official information about your Discord account, including product and feature announcements.

Note: You can modify your email preferences by going to User Settings > Notifications in the mobile, desktop or browser version of the Discord app.
